CRITICAL matched series framing: square canvas, head small enough: hair crown at 10% height, eyes at 30%, anatomical chin at 50%, head width 36–38%. Head horizontal center 50%. Do not crop sides, zoom into face, or auto-trim transparency. No waist, hands, new props. Preserve natural proportions. Head size consistency more important than filling canvas.
Fine dry-brush gothic painting, sculptural volume, matte skin, grouped hair, coarse worn cloth, subtle irregular strokes following form; deep chiaroscuro, light upper front-left. Muted earth charcoal bone colors. Not photograph, glossy 3D or cartoon.
Actual transparent PNG alpha outside silhouette, no black or white background, painted checkerboard, frame, labels, halo. Keep dark clothing and internal shadows opaque. One square portrait.
Image 5 is ONLY the series camera-distance/layout reference. MATCH its anatomical head height, eye-line and chin position closely; do NOT copy its face, skin, hair, clothing or shoulder width. Subject identity comes exclusively from image1. Every portrait in this series must have the same apparent camera distance. Preserve each person's natural build.
